# dsh-login-gateway
## Overview
Official `dsh web` only binds to localhost (`127.0.0.1`) and cannot be exposed directly to public ne
tworks. This plugin provides an authenticated entry point with a username/password login wall and re
verse proxies authenticated traffic to your local DeepSeek Harness instance.
It is designed for deploying Harness on cloud servers while securely accessing the workspace via bro
wser. By default, it listens on port `8080` under the `/dsh` path prefix to avoid conflicting with t
he default web port (`3080`).
Repository topics: `dsh-plugin`, `dsh-category-security`. The distributed package contains no hardco
ded credentials, domains, or public IPs; credentials are generated and stored exclusively on your ho
ials, domains, or public IPs; credentials are generated and stored exclusively on your host machine.

## Mobile Access
This plugin focuses on authentication and proxying and preserves the official desktop layout.
If you primarily access your workspace from a mobile browser, consider pairing it with the community
portrait layout plugin dsh-web-mobile in the same `web` profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh-login-gateway` manages authentication and routing, while `dsh-web-mobile` (package name `@dsh-e
xternal/dsh-mobile-nav`) provides mobile drawers, full-width chat layouts, and touch-adapted setting
s without affecting desktop displays.
## Quick Start & Configuration
For full setup instructions, configuration fields, and Nginx configurations, see docs/setup.md.
1. **Initial Credentials**: If a password was not preconfigured, find the generated credentials in t

he `dsh web` console output labeled `generated login`.
2. **Gateway Settings**: After logging in, na
vigate to **Settings → Gateway** and click **Gateway Settings** to change username, password, port,

and proxy options. You can also log out from this panel.
3. **Trusted Hosts**: The startup command m

ust include `--trusted-host <host>`, or official API endpoints will reject incoming traffic.
4. **Re
verse Proxy / Nginx**: If placing Nginx or Caddy in front, enable "Trust Reverse Proxy" and proxy `/

dsh`, `/assets/`, `/plugins/`, `/api`, `/dsh-image-gen`, and `/query-balance` to the gateway port.
5
. **Document Drops**: Dragging non-image documents (PDF, Markdown, text) into the browser uploads th
em to the server and inserts `@filename` references directly into the input prompt. Standard image a
ttachments (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) continue through the native media bar.
